verify-flow-views.summary: AdmissionPage.vue is the /verify/:code (route name 'admission-token', router/index.ts:197-204, meta layout:'none') admission flow controller for join.stuhelper.com. It drives a 12-value state machine (AdmissionPageState in admissionState.ts:3-15: loading, needsLogin, accountMismatch, qqMismatch, ready, linked, pendingReview, projectionPending, approved, invalid, expired, error) rendered through a shared shell (AdmissionShell), a 4-step progress strip (AdmissionProgress), generic state panels (AdmissionStatePanel), a reissue-command hint (AdmissionReissueHint), and a projection-sync notice (ProjectionPendingNotice). It orchestrates token preview → auth probe → QQ-binding mismatch precheck → explicit bind confirmation (typed-QQ dialog) → linkAdmissionSession → flow tabs (old-student vs freshman) → pendingReview visibility-gated polling → capability-projection bounded retry → approved. It handles consumed tokens via sessionStorage-remembered session IDs, stale-route guards after every await, a single-flight reload queue, and pageshow/focus/visibilitychange browser-return refresh. All copy is hardcoded Chinese (no i18n), and unit + e2e tests assert heavily on data-* attributes, data-state values, exact Chinese strings, heading roles, and two CSS classes (.primary-button, .flow-tab).
behavior_contract: STATE ENUM: AdmissionPageState = loading | needsLogin | accountMismatch | qqMismatch | ready | linked | pendingReview | projectionPending | approved | invalid | expired | error (admissionState.ts:3-15). pageState ref initialized to 'loading' (AdmissionPage.vue:398).

STATE MAPPING (session): stateFromAdmissionSession (admissionState.ts:17-28) — order matters: status==='joined_muted'→'ready' BEFORE projectionPending check; projectionPending→'projectionPending'; 'linked'→'linked'; 'material_submitted'→'pendingReview'; 'verified'→'approved'; 'expired_kicked'|'cancelled'→'expired'; fallthrough→'error'.

STATE MAPPING (me): stateFromAdmissionMe (admissionState.ts:30-40) — different order: projectionPending checked FIRST; then verified→approved, material_submitted→pendingReview, linked→linked, expired_kicked/cancelled→expired, else error. This asymmetry vs stateFromAdmissionSession is intentional and test-covered.

INITIAL LOAD loadAdmissionSession (AdmissionPage.vue:735-781): token = String(route.params.code) (471-473); sets pageState='loading', consumedTokenNeedsLogin=false; (1) try resumeRememberedAdmissionSession; (2) else admissionApi.getAdmissionSession(token) preview; (3) refreshAdmissionAuthState; if !authenticated → 'needsLogin'; (4) applyKnownQQMismatch(preview); (5) handleSessionState(preview). After EVERY await: isCurrentAdmissionRoute(requestToken) stale guard (746,749,757,760) — silently returns if route token changed.

REMEMBERED SESSION RESUME (604-631): reads sessionStorage 'admission_linked_session:<token>' (admissionToken.ts:24,81-101 via safe sessionStorage helpers). If present: refreshAdmissionAuthState → if !auth: consumedTokenNeedsLogin=true + 'needsLogin' (return true/handled); else getAdmissionMe(rememberedSessionID) → handleAdmissionMeState (return true). On getAdmissionMe error: forgetLinkedAdmissionSession(token); if isAdmissionSessionExpiredError → 'expired' (return true); else return false → FALLS THROUGH to normal token load.

AUTH PROBE refreshAdmissionAuthState (633-647): only probes if auth.isAuthenticated || hasStoredSessionHint() || consumeAdmissionAuthReturn(currentAdmissionURL()) — consumeAdmissionAuthReturn is side-effectful (deletes sessionStorage key, utils/auth.ts:217-223) and MUST stay last in the short-circuit chain. Probe = auth.bootstrapSession({ force: true }); on throw → fallback return auth.isAuthenticated (not false). Test asserts bootstrapSession NOT called when no hint and no oauth return (test:506-519).

QQ MISMATCH PRECHECK applyKnownQQMismatch (565-579): only when preview.status==='joined_muted' && preview.qqID truthy; verificationStore.fetchQQBinding(); if binding exists && binding.qqID !== session.qqID → pageState='qqMismatch' (return true). fetchQQBinding errors are swallowed (return false → continue to ready).

CONSUMED TOKEN PATH (758-778): on getAdmissionSession error with code 'admission.token_consumed' (isAdmissionTokenConsumedError, admissionToken.ts:65-67): re-probe auth; if !authenticated → consumedTokenNeedsLogin=true + 'needsLogin'; else resumeConsumedTokenSession (591-602) calls linkAdmissionSession(token) (idempotent re-link), stores session, rememberLinkedAdmissionSession, handleSessionState. If that re-link ALSO throws token_consumed → 'accountMismatch'; other resume errors → applyError. All other initial errors → applyError.

ERROR MAPPING applyError (487-492) + mapAdmissionApiError (admissionToken.ts:44-58): code 'admission.qq_mismatch' OR message matching /qq binding conflict/i → 'qqMismatch'; codes admission.token_not_found|admission.session_not_found → 'invalid'; admission.token_consumed|admission.token_expired → 'expired'; else 'error' and errorMessage reset to '认证链接暂时无法打开，请稍后重试。' (401,490). Error code read from ApiError.code, plain {code}, or nested {error:{code}} (admissionToken.ts:103-122).
EXPIRED DETECTION isAdmissionSessionExpiredError (admissionToken.ts:69-72): codes token_expired, token_not_found, session_not_found → handleAdmissionExpired() → pageState='expired' (910-912).

SINGLE-FLIGHT LOAD QUEUE queueAdmissionSessionLoad (783-795): if a load promise is in flight, set admissionSessionReloadQueued=true; on finally, clear and re-queue once. Prevents concurrent loadAdmissionSession runs (stale-load test:651-675 asserts exactly 2 getAdmissionSession calls, ABCD then EFGH, and final state 'ready' from the NEW token even though the old promise resolves later).

BROWSER-RETURN REFRESH (797-832): shouldRefreshAfterBrowserReturn = (pageState==='loading' && activeAdmissionRouteKey !== currentRouteKey) || state in {needsLogin, accountMismatch, error}. refreshAfterBrowserReturn: if pendingReview → clearPendingReviewRefresh + immediate refreshPendingReviewState (698-701); else if shouldRefresh → queueAdmissionSessionLoad. Listeners (onMounted 926-931, removed onBeforeUnmount 955-957): window 'pageshow' (fires refresh when event.persisted || shouldRefresh, 816-820), window 'focus' (830-832), document 'visibilitychange' (visible→refresh; hidden→clearPendingReviewRefresh, 822-828). Focus/pageshow on 'ready'/'linked' states must NOT trigger reload.
ROUTE CHANGE WATCH route.fullPath (933-942): resets activeFlowManuallySelected=false, closes bind dialog, clears bindConfirmationQQ + touched, queues a session reload.

PENDING REVIEW POLLING (387-392, 671-721, watch 944-950): delays [5000,10000,20000,30000]ms, attempt index capped at last entry (684-690). watch(pageState): entering 'pendingReview' → schedulePendingReviewRefresh(reset=true) (attempt counter reset); leaving → clearPendingReviewRefresh. schedulePendingReviewRefresh guards: state must be pendingReview, no timer already set, not in flight, document.visibilityState==='visible' (675). refreshPendingReviewState (703-721): in-flight flag; getAdmissionMe(session.value?.id); if still pendingReview → handleAdmissionMeState (advances to projectionPending/approved/etc.); on expired error → handleAdmissionExpired; finally clears in-flight and reschedules if still pendingReview. Browser return while pendingReview clears the timer and refreshes immediately (698-701, 807-809). Test asserts first poll fires at exactly 5000ms with the remembered session id (test:270-304).

PROJECTION REFRESH scheduleProjectionRefresh (649-664): resets projectionRefreshTimedOut=false; aborts previous AbortController, creates new one; waitForAdmissionProjection({ refreshAuth: auth.fetchUser, signal }) — projectionRefresh.ts: retry delays [1000,2000,4000,8000,16000] (lines 2-8); each iteration waits the delay (abortable), calls refreshAuth(), checks user.capabilities or user.globalCapabilities includes 'review:create' (ADMISSION_PROJECTED_CAPABILITY, lines 1,41-44). Resolves true → pageState='approved'; false → projectionRefreshTimedOut=true (shows timeout UI + retry button); rejection: AbortError (DOMException name==='AbortError', 960-962) swallowed, others → applyError. retryProjectionRefresh (666-669) only acts when pageState==='projectionPending'. onBeforeUnmount aborts (953). Tests assert exact call shape {refreshAuth: auth.fetchUser, signal: AbortSignal} (test:300-303,435-438,485-488).
PROJECTION ENTRY POINTS: handleSessionState (559-563), handleAdmissionMeState (581-589), and loadLinkedResources (523) all call scheduleProjectionRefresh when resulting state is 'projectionPending'.

LINKED RESOURCES loadLinkedResources (506-524): clears linkedResourceErrorMessage; Promise.all([verificationStore.fetchSchools(), refreshAdmission!==false ? admissionApi.getAdmissionMe(session.value?.id) : Promise.resolve(null)]). If nextAdmission: setAdmissionMe, session.value=nextAdmission.session (when present), pageState=stateFromAdmissionMe. If final state 'linked' → syncDefaultAdmissionFlow; if 'projectionPending' → scheduleProjectionRefresh. CRITICAL: handleSessionState→scheduleLinkedResourcesLoad() (refreshAdmission true, i.e. fetches getAdmissionMe) while handleAdmissionMeState→scheduleLinkedResourcesLoad({refreshAdmission:false}) (no second getAdmissionMe) — tests assert getAdmissionMe called exactly once (test:325-327,344-345).

LINKED RESOURCES ERROR handleLinkedResourcesLoadError (544-557): isAdmissionSessionExpiredError → 'expired'; else if currently 'linked' → set linkedResourceErrorMessage = error.message || '认证资料加载失败，请稍后重试。' (922-924) and stay on linked page with inline [data-linked-resource-error] block + '重新加载' retry button (retryLinkedResources, 918-920); otherwise applyError. Tests: stays linked showing 'admission me unavailable' inline, does NOT go to error state (test:677-696); cancelled/expired me responses move to expired (test:698-719,763-781).

setAdmissionMe (498-504): stores admissionMe; if nextAdmission.session?.id → rememberLinkedAdmissionSession(token, id) in sessionStorage; if !showFreshmanSubmission (credentialKind is school_sso or school_email_otp, oldStudentAdmission.ts:22-29) → force activeFlow='oldStudent'.

FLOW TAB LOGIC (405,407,478-485,526-538): activeFlow ref defaults 'freshman'; syncDefaultAdmissionFlow: if !showFreshmanSubmission → 'oldStudent' (forced); else if !activeFlowManuallySelected → 'oldStudent' when any school has SSO or EmailOTP enabled (schoolHasAdmissionSSO/schoolHasAdmissionEmailOTP require school.enabled===true, oldStudentAdmission.ts:10-20), else 'freshman'. selectAdmissionFlow sets activeFlowManuallySelected=true. Manual choice reset only on route.fullPath change.

LINKED STATE RENDER (113-179): section.admission-flow[data-state=linked]; header icon ShieldCheck + h2 '选择认证方式'; optional inline error block; two .flow-tab buttons ('老生认证'/'新生认证', active gets .flow-tab--active); OldStudentVerificationFlow when activeFlow==='oldStudent' (props: admission-session-id, current-return-url, linked, schools; events @expired→handleAdmissionExpired, @verified→handleOldStudentVerified→handleAdmissionMeState); FreshmanCameraFlow when activeFlow==='freshman' && showFreshmanSubmission (props: admission-session-id, max-material-bytes, schools; events @expired→expired, @submitted→markPendingReview→pageState='pendingReview' which starts polling via watch); else div[data-formal-student-credential] '已完成老生认证。'.

BIND CONFIRMATION DIALOG (250-321, 856-880): 'ready' panel button [data-admission-open-bind-confirmation] '开始认证' (label '正在确认...' while linking; :disabled=linking) opens dialog after resetting bindConfirmationQQ='' and touched=false. Dialog (shadcn-vue Dialog, teleported to body) [data-admission-bind-confirmation-dialog]: shows '[{currentUserLabel}]' (auth.user.displayName || name || '当前 StuHelper 账号', 420-422) and '[{displayQQ || 当前入群 QQ}]'. Input [data-admission-bind-confirmation-input] id=admission-bind-confirmation-qq, inputmode=numeric, autocomplete=off, placeholder=displayQQ||'QQ号', disabled while linking, @blur sets touched, @keydown.enter.prevent submits. Match rule (423-428): trim(input) === trim(session.qqID) and expected non-empty — whitespace-padded input accepted (test:607-627). Error p [data-admission-bind-confirmation-error] '输入的 QQ 号与本次入群 QQ 不一致。' only when touched && input non-empty && mismatch (429-434). Submit [data-admission-bind-confirmation-submit] disabled unless match && !linking; label '确认并开始认证'→'正在确认...'. Cancel button (variant outline) and open-change both refuse to close while linking (862-874); reopening resets input/touched.

CONFIRM LINK confirmLink (834-854): linking=true; admissionApi.linkAdmissionSession(token); on success: close dialog, session=linked, rememberLinkedAdmissionSession(token, linked.id), handleSessionState(linked). On error: close dialog; token_consumed → 'accountMismatch'; else applyError (qq_mismatch ApiError → 'qqMismatch', test:740-761). finally linking=false.

AUTH ACTIONS (882-892): needsLogin panel: '登录' → auth.login(currentAdmissionURL()); '注册' (hidden when consumedTokenNeedsLogin) → auth.signup(...); accountMismatch/qqMismatch panels: '重新登录' → auth.switchAccount(...). currentAdmissionURL = buildAdmissionReturnURL(route.fullPath) (494-496; admissionToken.ts:26-42): resolves against window.location.origin, must match /^\/verify\/[^/]+\/?$/, strips search+hash, throws on cross-origin or wrong path. e2e/unit assert exact 'http://localhost:3000/verify/ABCD' passed to switchAccount (test:757).

REISSUE COMMAND (435-439, 894-904): reissueCommand = displayQQ ? `重新生成认证链接 ${qq}` : '重新生成认证链接 <QQ号>'. copyReissueCommand: navigator.clipboard.writeText (throws if clipboard.writeText missing) → toast.success('重新生成指令已复制') or toast.error('复制失败，请手动复制'). AdmissionReissueHint rendered in help slot for accountMismatch, qqMismatch, invalid, expired states.

STATUS LABEL admissionStatusLabel (440-469) shown in shell '当前状态' fact: loading→'校验链接'; needsLogin→consumedTokenNeedsLogin?'等待原账号登录':'等待登录'; accountMismatch→'账号不匹配'; qqMismatch→'QQ 不匹配'; ready→'等待确认 QQ'; linked→'选择认证方式'; pendingReview→'等待审核'; projectionPending→'身份同步中'; approved→'认证通过'; invalid→'链接无效'; expired→'链接失效'; error→'加载失败'; default '处理中'.

AdmissionStatePanel (AdmissionStatePanel.vue): renders section.admission-state-panel.admission-state-panel--{tone} with data-state={state} attr; icon span aria-hidden; h2 title; one

per description line (string or string[] filtered with Boolean, 53-56); conditional body/actions/help slot wrappers (22-32). tone defaults 'neutral'; tones: danger/info/neutral/success/warning change only icon bg/color (130-148).

AdmissionProgress (AdmissionProgress.vue): renders ONLY when session non-null (v-if line 3) — error/invalid states reached before a session preview show no progress strip. section[data-admission-progress] aria-label='入群认证进度'. 4 fixed steps (90-111): account '账号绑定'/'登录 StuHelper 后绑定本次 QQ 入群会话'; student '学生认证'/'完成老生邮箱/统一认证，或提交新生材料'; review '审核同步'/'等待审核或身份状态同步'; release '解除禁言'/'机器人确认后解除禁言'. currentIndex (113-118): linked→1, pendingReview→2, projectionPending|approved→3, else 0. failed = pageState in {accountMismatch,error,expired,qqMismatch} (120-122) → current step state 'failed'; approved → ALL steps 'complete' (131); else complete<current<pending. Step li gets class admission-progress__step--{state} + [data-admission-progress-step]; current label in [data-admission-progress-current].

PROGRESS DEADLINES (139-165): activeDeadline — needsLogin|ready → {label:'绑定账号截止', value:session.linkWaitDeadlineAt}; linked → {'提交认证截止', submissionWaitDeadlineAt}; pendingReview && manualReviewDeadlineAt → {'审核处理截止', manualReviewDeadlineAt}; else null. Rendered in p[data-admission-active-deadline] as '{label}：<time datetime>{YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}</time>（{remaining}）'. approved with no deadline → same data attr with text '已通过认证，等待机器人同步群内状态。' (27-32). remainingText (185-196): past→'已超时'; <60min→'剩余 N 分钟' (Math.ceil); whole hours→'剩余 H 小时'; else '剩余 H 小时 M 分钟'; invalid date→''. muteUntilText (160-165): hidden when no session or state approved/expired; p[data-admission-mute-deadline] '群内临时禁言至 {initialMuteUntil formatted}；学生认证通过后会提前解除。'. 60_000ms setInterval updates nowMs onMounted, cleared onBeforeUnmount (167-179). Date format via formatDate(value,'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm') (181-183).

AdmissionShell (AdmissionShell.vue): main.admission-shell > section.admission-shell__frame > header (eyebrow 'StuHelper JOIN', h1 '入群身份认证', description '请按当前步骤完成账号绑定和学生身份认证。认证通过后，机器人会继续处理群内状态。') + dl.admission-shell__facts[aria-label=认证上下文] with two facts: '目标 QQ' dd = displayQq ? `QQ：${displayQq}` : '等待读取' (e2e asserts getByText('QQ：123456')); '当前状态' dd = statusLabel. Then section.admission-shell__panel with named slot 'progress' followed by div.admission-shell__content default slot.

API SURFACE used by this page (api.ts): admissionApi.getAdmissionSession(token) GET preview; admissionApi.linkAdmissionSession(token) POST link/consume; admissionApi.getAdmissionMe(admissionSessionID?) — id passed when known (437-439). All responses runtime-validated (readAdmissionSession/readAdmissionMe, api.ts:231-307) — invalid payloads throw Error with fixed messages; requireData throws result.error, or result.data when success===false/error present (61-73).

LIFECYCLE: onMounted adds pageshow/focus/visibilitychange listeners then queueAdmissionSessionLoad (926-931). onBeforeUnmount: abort projection controller, clear pendingReview timer, remove all 3 listeners (952-958).

TOKEN/SESSION PERSISTENCE: sessionStorage key 'admission_linked_session:<token>' written on every successful link and every AdmissionMe with session.id (501,599,842); read on load (605); deleted when getAdmissionMe for remembered id fails (624). Storage access wrapped in safe helpers that swallow storage exceptions (admissionToken.ts:81-101).

camera-flows.summary: The freshman camera capture slice has three parts: (1) cameraCapture.ts — a pure browser-API utility layer wrapping getUserMedia (rear-facing camera, no audio), canvas-based JPEG frame capture to base64 with client-side size-limit enforcement, stream teardown, and a Chinese error-copy mapper keyed on DOMException names and exact English error-message strings; (2) FreshmanCameraFlow.vue — the desktop in-page flow embedded in AdmissionPage (/verify/:code) that collects school/name/dept/materialType, lazily creates a FreshmanApplication on first submit/handoff, captures+uploads camera material, and offers a desktop-to-mobile handoff via QR code (qrcode npm) whose status is tracked live via an SSE EventSource at a hardcoded path with a 1500ms polling fallback, including a cross-device locking state machine (pending/uploaded/locked[desktop|mobile]/expired) that disables desktop controls and emits submitted/expired to the parent; (3) FreshmanMobileCameraPage.vue — a standalone, auth-free route /admission/freshman/camera/:token that previews the handoff by token, captures and uploads from the phone, then lets the user choose continuation (desktop vs mobile), with rigorous stale-token/stale-response guards (a load sequence counter plus token equality checks on every async resolution) and stream cleanup on play() failure, upload success, expiry, token change, and unmount. All user-facing copy is hardcoded Chinese (no i18n), and both unit tests (vitest + @vue/test-utils with heavy browser-API monkey-patching) and Playwright e2e tests assert on data-attributes, button class names/DOM order, role+accessible-name (Chinese text), exact API paths/payloads, and the SSE URL.

logic-layer.summary: The admission logic layer of join.stuhelper.com consists of five framework-free TS modules plus one form component. api.ts wraps the shared openapi client (api.admission) with 13 methods that strictly runtime-validate every response field (enums, integer-or-string IDs, absolute http(s) URLs, null/undefined distinctions) and throw exact English error strings. admissionState.ts maps backend session/me status to a 12-value page-state union with deliberately asymmetric ordering. admissionToken.ts handles return-URL hardening (/verify/:code same-origin only), error-code/message-regex classification of admission API errors, and sessionStorage persistence of linked session IDs keyed by token. projectionRefresh.ts is a bounded exponential-backoff (1s/2s/4s/8s/16s) poller waiting for the 'review:create' capability with full AbortSignal support. OldStudentVerificationFlow.vue implements school selection, school-SSO redirect, and a school-email-OTP flow with a 300ms-debounced, runID-race-guarded academic student-ID/name match that auto-derives the student email (BUAA policy). The five .ts modules are pure and reusable as-is; the .vue file entangles a six-state academic-match machine, trimming/reset semantics, and hardcoded zh-CN copy with markup that tests select via data-* attributes and DOM order.

rewrite_risks: Teleported dialog: admissionPageStates tests query document.body (getDialogElement), NOT the wrapper — the bind-confirmation dialog must keep rendering into body (current shadcn/reka Dialog behavior) with all four data-admission-bind-confirmation-* attributes; an inline modal would break every bind-flow test.

Timing constants are asserted exactly with fake timers: pendingReview first poll 5000ms (then 10000/20000/30000 backoff), SSE-fallback polling 1500ms, academic-match debounce 300ms, projection backoff [1000,2000,4000,8000,16000], plus 'no getAdmissionMe at t=0' assertions. Any change to these numbers or to when timers are scheduled breaks tests.

settleAdmissionPage budget: AdmissionPage must reach steady state within flushPromises x2 + one setTimeout(0) + nextTick. Introducing extra async hops (transitions, lazy child mounting, suspense, debounced loads) will make assertions observe intermediate states.

Race-condition guards are individually tested and easy to lose in a rewrite: (a) stale-route guard after EVERY await in loadAdmissionSession (token changed mid-flight); (b) mobile page stale preview AND stale upload dropping after token change (incl. e2e popstate test); (c) SSE stale-source filtering after handoff regeneration (events from old EventSource must be ignored even though it was closed); (d) load serialization with single queued reload; (e) in-flight dedup on every mutating button (link, application+handoff, upload, continuation, OTP verify) implemented as disabled + internal flags — double-click tests use deferred promises.

Auth-probe discipline: needsLogin must be derivable WITHOUT network calls when there is no session hint and no admission auth-return marker (bootstrapSession not called — unit test), and join-host public/error pages must generate ZERO /auth/me and /auth/refresh requests (e2e asserts counts with expect.poll). Eagerly bootstrapping auth in a rewritten page/layout breaks both.
linkAdmissionSession must never send a qq parameter (three e2e tests capture the /link URL and assert qq===''); the typed-QQ confirmation is client-side only and must trim whitespace.

Negative assertions on API calls: getAdmissionMe NOT called in accountMismatch resume, before first pendingReview tick, or on stale reload; fetchSchools NOT called on stale reload or in needsQQBinding; createFreshmanCameraHandoff NOT called until application resolves; uploadCameraCapture NOT called while continuation undecided or over size limit; admission APIs never called from /start. A rewrite that prefetches or parallelizes differently will fail these.

e2e fixtures fail tests on ANY console.error / pageerror / unexpected 4xx-5xx (whitelist is narrow: admission sessions GET 400/404/409/410 only — admission/me, link, OTP, handoff errors are NOT whitelisted, so the rewrite must keep handling those without letting the requests 4xx unmocked or logging errors). The console-error whitelist regex references the literal filename 'AdmissionPage.vue' in a dynamic-import failure pattern — renaming the component file invalidates that expectation.

Every e2e spec runs twice: Desktop Chrome AND Pixel 5 mobile emulation. Rewritten layouts must keep all asserted controls visible/clickable at mobile width (Playwright auto-waits for visibility; an element hidden behind a collapsed accordion/menu on mobile fails).

Browser-event wiring: window 'pageshow' (incl. bfcache persisted flag), window 'focus', document 'visibilitychange' (hidden must PAUSE pendingReview polling; visible resumes/refreshes). Unit tests dispatch bare Event objects on window — listeners must be on window/document, not on the component root.

EventSource is feature-detected via typeof window.EventSource === 'function' and constructed off window (tests replace the window property); using a fetch-based SSE client or importing EventSource differently breaks the FakeEventSource stubs. The 'handoff' named event (addEventListener('handoff')) and the exact stream URL path are asserted.

Camera lifecycle: tracks .stop() must run on component unmount, after successful upload, on expired, and on video.play() rejection (which must also restore the open-camera button and surface the raw error message). e2e polls a __cameraStopCount===1 — double-stopping or leaking the stream both fail.

Markup-coupled selectors that constrain the redesign unless tests are updated: .flow-tab class + '新生认证' label (tab switcher), button.primary-button (qqMismatch action), button.secondary-button DOM-order (open-camera then capture in FreshmanCameraFlow), button.join-start-primary-button/-secondary-button, <form> element wrapping freshman desktop submission and the OTP form, findAll('input').at(-1) (OTP code must stay the last input in OldStudentVerificationFlow), img[alt='录取材料预览'], label associations for 姓名/院系或专业/验证码, heading roles (h1/h2) for all getByRole heading assertions. Either preserve these or budget test updates — everything else uses stable data-* hooks.

Hardcoded-copy coupling: ~80 assertions match exact Chinese strings (including full sentences with punctuation like '手机已上传材料，请在手机上选择回到电脑端继续或在手机端继续。'). Introducing i18n or editing copy during the rewrite silently breaks unit+e2e tests; treat copy as frozen for the rewrite.

Error-shape tolerance: error mapping must work on plain objects ({code}, {error:{code}}) not just ApiError instances, must map legacy A0000409 by message regex ('qq binding conflict' → qqMismatch; 'admission camera handoff locked' → locked-handoff handling), and the 404 mobile-handoff error must be masked with friendly copy while other errors surface raw messages ('play blocked', 'consumed', 'admission me unavailable' are asserted to appear verbatim).
